description: Send a prompt to any AWS Bedrock model via the Converse API. Supports Claude, GPT, Grok, Kimi, Gemma, Mistral, Nova, Qwen, DeepSeek, and more. Use short aliases (e.g. 'claude-sonnet', 'nova-pro') or full model IDs. Pass schema to get JSON that matches it, and effort to set the thinking depth.

effort.description: Thinking depth and token spend for models that take it (Claude except Haiku 4.5, GPT-6.1, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4 up to xhigh): low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Claude Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default to medium. bedrock_ask rejects it for other models; bedrock_compare and bedrock_judge apply it only to the models that take it.

model.description: Model alias (e.g. 'claude-opus', 'kimi', 'mistral-large', 'nova-pro', 'deepseek') or full Bedrock model ID

prompt.description: The user prompt to send to the model

schema.description: JSON schema the reply must match (structured output). Object schemas need additionalProperties: false. Supported by Claude, GPT-6.1, GPT-OSS, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4, Mistral Large 3, Ministral 3, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3.2, MiniMax M2.5 and Nemotron 3 Super; not by Nova, Pixtral or Magistral Small.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0-1, default 0.7). Ignored by models that don't support it.

name: bedrock_ask
